# just Results Consulting

> Trustworthy operational AI for energy and process industry. Agentic systems that regulators trust and operators can defend — calibrated, human-gated, audit-grade, and self-hosted.

just Results Consulting a.s is a Norwegian advisory firm founded by Leif Næss (MSc, PhD, MBA). It builds agentic AI for industrial operations where a decision has to survive a safety review, an auditor, and a board — process industry, energy, offshore wind, oil and gas, and discrete manufacturing. Most mandates run eight to twenty weeks and leave the organisation able to make the next decision without us.

The differentiator is not the machine learning. It is that the same person can defend the physics of the underlying process model, the calibration of the prediction, and the regulatory position it has to hold — a combination normally split across a data scientist, a process engineer, and a lawyer.

## What we build

- **Predictive maintenance an operator can defend** — failure prediction wired to audited, human-gated action rather than to a dashboard nobody opens.
- **Guardrails for agentic AI** — deterministic clamp, block, and escalate layers that keep an autonomous agent inside limits a regulator will accept.
- **Conformity evidence for industrial ML** — calibration, conformal intervals, drift monitoring, and tamper-evident audit trails mapped to EU AI Act, NIS2, and IEC 62443 obligations.
- **On-premises document intelligence** — engineering document estates turned into evidence-backed, provenance-cited answers, with no SaaS dependency.

Strategy, change management, and technology advisory remain part of the practice and underpin every engagement — corporate strategy facilitation, large-scale organisational change, turnarounds, and business-process optimisation. The specialism, though, is operational AI in regulated industry.

## Demonstrators

Two working demonstrators carry the claims. Both run on public or bundled data, so neither depends on client material.

- **Trusted Operational AI** — a predictive-maintenance agent acting on two industrial assets, an oil-and-gas well and an offshore-wind energy system. Every prediction is calibrated, explained, drift-checked, human-gated, and written to an append-only hash-chained audit trail. A staged autonomy ladder — Observe, Recommend, Approve, Auto-bounded, Auto — is governed by confidence, severity, cost, and reversibility guardrails with a drift fail-safe. In the wind case the failure risk steers battery and grid-export dispatch. Three audience views: engineer, domain expert, decision-maker. Audience: energy, oil and gas, and offshore-wind operators acting under EU AI Act, NIS2, and IEC 62443 obligations.

- **Guardrails for Agentic AI** — a standalone demonstrator running a miniature Norwegian electricity provider on real ENTSO-E load data for bidding zone NO1, offline, in one browser tab. A deliberately over-reaching agent proposes grid-balancing actions; a deterministic guardrail layer of plain auditable code, with no machine learning in it, intercepts every proposal to pass, clamp, block, or escalate, behind an operator kill-switch and a monitored path back to autonomy. Guardrails are live-editable: change a threshold and watch the outcome change. It produces two regulator-shaped incident reports, NVE/RME with REMIT, and EU AI Act. It is a demonstrator, not a production controller — no real assets move, and the incident reports are illustrative rather than certified filings.

## Products

- **CatalyzeAI** — an on-premises platform that turns a company's document estate into evidence-backed answers, cross-document comparisons, and a structured innovation shortlist. A staged Scout, Maverick, Skeptic, Synthesizer pipeline with a single Discovery Stance dial for governance. Bundled domain ontologies — ISO 15926-14, IOF Core, CORA, SSN/SOSA — plus customer OWL imports. Built for small and medium-sized enterprises in process, energy, and manufacturing. Runs fully on customer hardware; no data leaves the estate.

just Results also builds and runs two internal tools on the same self-hosted, audit-grade architecture: **Practice Cockpit**, an operating substrate for a single-operator practice, and **Pocket Polymath**, a personal answering assistant that mechanically probes every cited URL before an answer renders. They demonstrate the architecture rather than define the practice.

Practice Cockpit is built on the AIS-OS framework by Nate Herk for the AI Automation Society community. The Three Ms of AI™ (Mindset, Method, Machine) is a trademark of Nate Herk. The productized cockpit layer — morning-briefing pipeline, two-stage answering chain with mechanical URL verification, dynamic sparring queue, and the deployment substrate — is built and operated by just Results.

## Sectors

- Process industry and chemicals
- Energy, including offshore wind, oil and gas, and grid operations
- Discrete manufacturing and automotive
- Academic and public-sector clients

## About the founder

Leif Næss is founder and CEO of just Results Consulting. He holds an MSc and a PhD in thermodynamics and large-scale dynamic and steady-state process simulation, and an MBA in strategy and innovation. He has spent three decades across energy, process, and automotive industry, advising boards and shop floors in industrial, academic, and public-sector organisations, on corporate turnarounds, merger integrations, business-process optimisation, and national cluster development. He has worked on practical agentic AI since 2024.

The combination that matters commercially: the process model and the investment case in one head, and a rigorous-simulation background that makes it possible to state where a model is valid and where it is not.
